summary: Mitsuhamizu 提出仅在钱包界面实现的防地址投毒方案：收款方分享短期收款码，发送方钱包用 Keccak256(地址加收款码) 生成动态大小写指纹。fede_intern 为 EIP-7825 辩护：它限制交易大小，但让 ZK 证明更可靠。

items.title: ethresear.ch：探索用动态大小写校验和缓解地址投毒
items.note: （Mitsuhamizu）08:59：投毒利用人们只核对首尾，收款方分享短期收款码，发送方钱包用 Keccak256(地址加收款码) 生成动态大小写指纹，粘贴仿冒地址时指纹不符。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Exploring dynamic casing checksums to mitigate address poisoning
items.note_en: (Mitsuhamizu), 08:59: poisoning works because people check only prefix and suffix, so the receiver shares a short lived code and the sender's wallet derives a dynamic casing fingerprint from Keccak256(address plus code) that fails for a pasted lookalike.

summary_en: Mitsuhamizu proposed a wallet UI only defense against address poisoning: the receiver shares a short lived code and the sender's wallet derives a dynamic casing fingerprint from Keccak256(address plus code). fede_intern defended EIP-7825: it caps transaction size but makes ZK proving reliable.
